# Amanpreet Singh - Software Developer

Amanpreet Singh is a software developer based in Sirsa, Haryana, India, and a prospective applicant to the University of Aizu (ICT Global All-English Program). His public work focuses on dependency-free C++17 systems programming and offline-capable Vanilla JavaScript applications.

Verified technical capabilities across public repositories:
- C++17 (ISO/IEC 14882:2017): header-only feed-forward neural inference kernels (`Infer-C`), row-major `std::vector<float>` tensor storage, `i-k-j` loop interchange with 4-way K-unrolling, runtime aliasing checks, binary weight validation, numerical tolerance tests, and GitHub Actions ASan/UBSan CI.
- Client Web Architecture: semantic HTML5, CSS3 (Grid, Flexbox, custom properties), Vanilla JavaScript ES6+, HTML5 Canvas 2D particle physics (Coulomb repulsion, Hooke's law springs, Euler-Cromer integration), Web Storage API (`localStorage`), and selective integration of GSAP, Anime.js, Leaflet, and Tailwind CSS where appropriate.
- Public Projects:
  - InferC (`https://github.com/Amanpreet6656/Infer-C`): Header-only C++17 neural network inference library.
  - Nihongo Syntax Matrix (`https://github.com/Amanpreet6656/Nihongo-syntax-matrix`): Rule-based offline-capable Japanese verb conjugation and calendar grammar explorer.
  - Smart Kanji Analyzer (`https://github.com/Amanpreet6656/smart-kanji-analyzer`): Client-side Unicode kanji extractor and JLPT study flashcard tool backed by `kanjiapi.dev`.
  - Japan Seismic & Weather Dashboard (`https://github.com/Amanpreet6656/Japan-seismic-weather-dashboard`): Real-time USGS seismic, Open-Meteo `jma_seamless`, and Wolfx EEW dashboard using Leaflet mapping, Midorikawa (1999) Shindo estimation, and MOE WBGT calculation.
  - BuildLedger Pro (`https://github.com/Amanpreet6656/BuildLedger-Pro`): Bilingual (English/Hindi) construction payroll and attendance tracker built with HTML5, Tailwind CSS, Vanilla JS, and `localStorage`.

Contact: amanpreetsingh21605@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/Amanpreet6656
